notes.title: NEW GAME: TRUFFLE | Available Now for Free
notes.content:
Hello!

My newest game "TRUFFLE" has just released! It is a complete remake of the original in a new game engine and with over double the content! This is my first sequel and I hope everyone enjoys this better version of the game!

- Ethan Robichaux

About TRUFFLE:

TRUFFLE is a minimalist puzzle maze game where touching the walls kills you instantly. It is a high difficulty, patience testing, dexterity game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684930/TRUFFLE/

notes.title: NEW GAME: The Wailer | AVAILABLE FREE NOW
notes.content:
Hello!

My latest game is out now for free on Steam! It is called 'The Wailer', and it is a highly stylized horror adventure game set in the depths of an ancient dungeon. 

I hope that you all enjoy this new game, it is the biggest one I've made so far!

-Ethan Robichaux

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2284260/The_Wailer/

notes.title: NEW GAME: Alignment
notes.content:
Vultive Entertainment's newest game Alignment is available now!

About Alignment:
[list]
[*]Alignment is a challenging and engaging puzzle game that will require you to move colored objects and place them on their respective platforms to explore through a series of increasingly complex levels
[*]It is also a game of discovering patterns, unraveling systems, and finding hidden meanings
[*]With an average playtime of 1 hour, this game will challenge your ability to piece together various systems as you progress
[*]You will also encounter different endings depending on your journey towards success. Can you uncover all 5 possible endings?
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2284900/Alignment/

notes.title: From the TRUFFLE dev comes Vermis Orbita, an action arcade game! Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello!

I am extremely happy that my second game, Vermis Orbita is available now! This game took about 1 month of development, so as always I look forward to the feedback that players will give. It is a short arcade game about surviving as long as possible. I hope that you all will enjoy this game, thank you for playing!

- Ethan Robichaux
Developer

notes.title: TRUFFLE hits 1000 Players!
notes.content:
TRUFFLE has just hit 1000 players! Thank you all so much for playing my game!

This update is just changing some company branding, as Mink Game Studios will now be operating under the name Vultive Entertainment. 

Thank you to everyone who supported this game by playing it, a sequel is going to happen at some point because of all of the positive feedback.

- Ethan Robichaux
Lead Game Developer
